items.title: Loading Screen Text Clarity
items.what: The loading screen text (“Downloading the game”) is very small and low contrast against the background. It's difficult to read quickly, especially on a phone.
items.why: Players may be unsure if the game is actually loading, leading to frustration and potential app abandonment.
items.how: Increase the font size of the text and/or add a subtle background shape to improve contrast. Consider a progress bar.

items.title: Score Contrast
items.what: The player scores (0 and 30) in the top HUD are a very similar color to the warm background, making them hard to read at a glance.
items.why: Players need to quickly understand the score. Low contrast hinders this, impacting engagement and competitive play.
items.how: Increase the contrast of the score text. A slightly brighter white or a subtle dark outline would help.

items.title: Control Overlap with HUD
items.what: The bottom control circles overlap slightly with the HUD elements, especially the 'Moves' button. This is visible in multiple screenshots.
items.why: This overlap makes it harder to accurately tap the HUD elements and can lead to accidental button presses.
items.how: Adjust the padding or positioning of the control circles and/or HUD elements to ensure they do not overlap.

items.title: Technique List Text Size
items.what: The text within the technique list modal (e.g., “RIGHT STICK FORWARD”) is very small and dense, making it difficult to scan and read on a phone screen.
items.why: Players will struggle to quickly learn and understand the available techniques, hindering gameplay and creating a frustrating experience.
items.how: Increase the font size of the technique list text and add more line spacing to improve readability.

items.title: Fighter and Mat Spacing
items.what: The fighters are positioned too high in the frame, leaving a large, empty area of the tatami mat below them. This is consistent across most fight scenes.
items.why: The wasted space feels unbalanced and detracts from the focus on the fighters. It makes the scene feel less dynamic.
items.how: Adjust the camera position or fighter scale to lower the fighters in the frame, reducing the empty space below them. Consider a slight zoom-out.
